title: Pulsar Client launches
body: Welcome to Pulsar Client! Real Microsoft login, capes, and a curated mod set powered by Fabric, Sodium, Iris, and Lithium.

title: Cosmetics: capes are live
body: Equip a cape from the Cosmetics tab. More cosmetic types are coming in future updates.

title: Mod manifest updates without a launcher rebuild
body: The mod list is now served from the backend, so we can push updates instantly without requiring you to download a new launcher version.
